moisture.notes: Volumetric water content. Below 30%: drought stress. Above 70%: waterlogging risk.

ph.notes: Slightly acidic to neutral. Below 5.5: nutrient lockout. Above 7.0: micronutrient deficiency.

temperature.notes: Air temperature. Below 10°C: chilling injury risk. Above 30°C: blossom drop.

humidity.notes: Relative humidity. Above 70%: fungal disease risk (early blight, late blight, leaf mold).
